info.name: Retrieves a list of all access requests in a compartment.

params.name: lockboxId
params.description: The unique identifier (OCID) of the associated lockbox.

params.name: id
params.description: A generic Id query param used to filter lockbox, access request and approval template by Id.

params.name: displayName
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the entire display name given.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description: A filter to return only resources their lifecycleState matches the given lifecycleState.

params.name: lockboxPartner
params.description: The name of the lockbox partner.

params.name: partnerId
params.description: The ID of the partner.

params.name: requestorId
params.description: The unique identifier (OCID) of the requestor in which to list resources.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description: A token representing the position at which to start retrieving results. This must come from the `opc-next-page` header field of a previous response.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. Default order for timeCreated is descending. Default order for displayName is ascending.

params.name: timeCreatedAfter
params.description: Date and time on or after which Access Requests were created, as described in [RFC 3339](https://tools.ietf.org/rfc/rfc3339)

params.name: timeCreatedBefore
params.description: Date and time on or before which Access requests were created, as described in [RFC 3339](https://tools.ietf.org/rfc/rfc3339)

items.docs: Retrieves a list of AccessRequestSummary objects in a compartment.
